geometry_contract.unvalidated_geometry_rule: While geometry_validation_status is GEOMETRY_NOT_VALIDATED (LASC 2018 headers carry unit spacing and zero origin, QA-002 F2), shape and index_convention are authoritative and spacing/origin/direction are the header's default affine in voxel-index units, not millimetres. Index-space operations (slices, overlays, meshes in voxel coordinates, slice picking) are served. No response carries a physical length, area, volume, mm or mL value; an operation that needs physical units answers GEOMETRY_NOT_VALIDATED.

review_rules.decision: FR-REV-001 states and 05 section 6 transitions, in contract v1.0 by the leader on 2026-10-01 (V4-06); scope and concurrency per DR-009
review_rules.notes: A transition not listed in review_status_transitions, including a repeat of the current state, is INVALID_REVIEW_TRANSITION. ACCEPTED -> FLAGGED/CORRECTED is allowed because every transition is appended to an immutable state history. PATCH to CORRECTED needs at least one persisted ReviewedMask; a commit always leaves the review CORRECTED and, on a review that is already CORRECTED, adds a version without a transition. ACCEPTED means accepted by the project reviewer for this research workflow, never clinical verification. The review revision is one monotonic counter advanced by every write (status, working-mask slice, commit); revision, working_revision and the commit's revision all report it.

case_capability.withheld_ground_truth_rule: A case may be served in INFERENCE_REVIEW mode although its source package carries a reference mask (INT-12: the lowest-numbered final_holdout case other than CASE_0027, chosen by rule before any metric exists). The API then serves neither that mask nor any value derived from it: every case-scoped ground-truth-dependent endpoint answers GROUND_TRUTH_UNAVAILABLE and no worst-slice selection, slice error or error mesh is served for it. Predictions, reviews, reviewed masks and findings remain available. The dataset is untouched and the offline evaluation population is unchanged.
case_capability.case_level_scope: For experiment-level endpoints the rule applies per case: cohort summaries are computed from the saved per-case results of the whole evaluation population, and no per-case value of an INFERENCE_REVIEW case is served.

worst_slice_selection.eligibility: slices whose ground truth is non-empty; both-empty NOT_APPLICABLE slices and empty-ground-truth FP-only slices are excluded
worst_slice_selection.order: slices are served ranked, worst first, over every eligible slice; the client preserves the order and never re-ranks
worst_slice_selection.empty_rule: an empty slices array means no eligible slice; it is never padded

outlier_selection.eligibility: SUCCEEDED rows of the explicitly selected experiment and prediction variant; FAILED, EXCLUDED and WITHHELD rows are never candidates
outlier_selection.order: cases are served ranked, worst first; the client preserves the order and never re-ranks

metric_rules.relative_volume_error_unit: percent of the ground-truth voxel count (07 section 6; voxel count while geometry is not validated)
metric_rules.empty_slice_rule: a both-empty slice is metric_state NOT_APPLICABLE with metric_value null, never 0 or 1 (07 section 6)
metric_rules.summary_rule: metric_summary maps every case_metric_field to an object with every summary_statistics key, each a number or null (null = not computed); experiment_compare.summary maps each compared experiment_id to a metric_summary over the common evaluation population
metric_rules.unavailable_rule: without a saved artifact the endpoint answers ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND (or RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED for a run that has not succeeded); an INFERENCE_REVIEW case answers GROUND_TRUTH_UNAVAILABLE; a metric value is never synthesised

binary_delivery.decision: 11 sections 2 and 4 allow a versioned artifact URL for large binary payloads; ADR-ART-001 remains open for compression and transport tuning
binary_delivery.metadata_rule: these endpoints answer application/json carrying every response field, including content_url and media_type; the bytes are fetched from content_url
binary_delivery.content_url_rule: content_url is immutable and content-addressed under /api/v1/artifacts/; its bytes hash to the response checksum (sha256:<hex>) and the artifact route answers them with an ETag equal to that checksum
binary_delivery.slice_layout: 8-bit single-channel PNG at native resolution: height Ny rows, width Nx columns, row = y, column = x, top-left origin (DR-008a); no resampling
binary_delivery.mask_payload_rule: working_mask_put sends mask_payload {encoding, data}: PNG_BASE64 is a base64 8-bit PNG of exactly Ny x Nx pixels with values {0, 255}; BITPACK_BASE64 is base64 of Ny*Nx bits, row-major, most significant bit first, 1 = foreground

hero_flow.decision: DEP-04 / INT-11, leader 2026-10-01: endpoints with hero_flow true are the subset the backend implements first, for the hero flow H1-H10 of management/DEMO_STANDARD.md
hero_flow.picking: 2D <-> 3D picking resolves through the shared geometry contract (geometry_get, mesh_to_world_transform; 11 section 7). An error-region -> slice map waits on DR-005 and is not part of v1.0.

errors.message_template: The requested case does not exist.
The requested slice index is outside the validated volume.
Ground-truth-dependent data is unavailable for this case.
The review state transition is not allowed.
The resource revision is stale; reload before writing.
An immutable artifact version cannot be overwritten.
The source geometry is not validated for this operation.
The supplied geometry does not match the source contract.
The requested experiment configuration is not deployable.
The analysis run has not produced a successful result.
The experiments do not share a fair evaluation contract.
The analysis run failed; inspect its recorded failure reason.
The caller is not authorized for this operation.

endpoints.semantic: Get study identity, dataset, counts, capabilities, and available experiment summary.
endpoints.notes: Only de-identified study identifiers are exposed. case_counts counts cases by mode; experiment_summary.status is AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE with a reason, never an invented summary.

endpoints.semantic: List cases with bounded pagination/search and mode filtering.
endpoints.notes: Optional query parameters mode=EVALUATION|INFERENCE_REVIEW, q (case id search), limit and page. Top-level mode echoes the mode filter applied (null when none); every row states its own mode_capability and ground-truth availability. An empty page is items: [].

endpoints.semantic: Get case mode, ground-truth availability, volume geometry, and run IDs.
endpoints.notes: Runtime values come from the validated package. mode is EVALUATION or INFERENCE_REVIEW (case_capability).

endpoints.semantic: Return or reference one MRI slice after range validation.
endpoints.notes: Large payloads use a versioned artifact URL (binary_delivery).

endpoints.semantic: Return a ground-truth slice only when the reference mask exists.
endpoints.notes: Never return an all-zero placeholder for missing ground truth. An INFERENCE_REVIEW case answers GROUND_TRUTH_UNAVAILABLE.

endpoints.semantic: Return the validated index-to-world geometry contract.
endpoints.notes: 2D and 3D clients consume the same transform contract.

endpoints.semantic: List frozen experiment configurations and comparability summaries.
endpoints.notes: Only deployable or explicitly recorded configurations are listed.

endpoints.semantic: Get model, split, subset, preprocessing, checkpoint, and evaluation versions.
endpoints.notes: Experiment identity is versioned and reproducible.

endpoints.semantic: Return cohort metrics from saved per-case results.
endpoints.notes: Excluded and failed cases remain visible in counts/status. metric_summary maps each case metric to summary_statistics (metric_rules).

endpoints.semantic: Return per-case metric/status rows for outlier drill-down.
endpoints.notes: Failed and excluded rows are not silently dropped. Row status is case_result_status; metric_values carries the case metrics for SUCCEEDED rows and is null otherwise; an INFERENCE_REVIEW case is a WITHHELD row with null values (case_capability). outlier_selection follows selection_rules.outlier_selection (DR-010).

endpoints.semantic: Compare experiments only over a common compatible evaluation population.
endpoints.notes: The client must not label a false comparison as fair.

endpoints.semantic: Request a run only for a frozen deployable compatible configuration.
endpoints.notes: Creation does not invent missing references.

endpoints.semantic: Return run state, attempt identity, provenance, artifacts, and failure reason.
endpoints.notes: Failure information remains queryable.

endpoints.semantic: Return run metrics with explicit reference and prediction IDs, and the DR-010 worst-slice selection.
endpoints.notes: Both-empty slices follow the NOT_APPLICABLE/NaN rule. metric_values carries the case-level 3D metrics (metric_rules); worst_slice_selection follows selection_rules.worst_slice_selection (DR-010a option b).

endpoints.semantic: Return one slice metric state/value under the empty-slice rule.
endpoints.notes: NOT_APPLICABLE is explicit, never coerced to zero.

endpoints.semantic: Return FP/FN/overlap data or a versioned error artifact.
endpoints.notes: Error semantics are versioned and traceable.

endpoints.semantic: Return the explicitly requested raw or processed prediction variant.
endpoints.notes: The backend never silently substitutes processed for raw.

endpoints.semantic: Return a mesh reference tied to the exact source mask and transform.
endpoints.notes: Mesh linkage is explicit, never inferred from a filename.

endpoints.semantic: Return 3-D error reconstruction only with a compatible reference.
endpoints.notes: A missing compatible ground truth is an explicit unavailable response.

endpoints.semantic: Create or initialize a persisted review state scoped to one source mask and prediction variant.
endpoints.notes: Initial state is persisted and auditable. status is one of review_rules.create_allowed_states. A review already open for the same run, source mask and variant is returned unchanged when the requested status is NOT_REVIEWED or equal to its status; any other status answers INVALID_REVIEW_TRANSITION (use review_patch).

endpoints.semantic: Update only an allowed review state transition.
endpoints.notes: The prior revision remains auditable. Allowed transitions are domain_enums.review_status_transitions.

endpoints.semantic: Upload one brush-edited working slice tied to an exact source mask.
endpoints.notes: Ground truth cannot be used as an implicit source prediction. source_mask_id must be the review's source mask; geometry_contract_version and geometry_validation_status must equal the case's. mask_payload follows binary_delivery.mask_payload_rule.

endpoints.semantic: Commit working edits as a new immutable ReviewedMask version.
endpoints.notes: Commit never overwrites raw, processed, or prior reviewed masks. The commit itself moves the review to CORRECTED (review_rules.commit_result_state) and answers a NEW reviewed_mask_id; a review_patch to CORRECTED afterwards is INVALID_REVIEW_TRANSITION. provenance records FR-REV-010 (source mask, case, run, time, reviewer when available).

endpoints.semantic: List immutable reviewed-mask versions and their provenance.
endpoints.notes: All prior versions remain addressable.

endpoints.semantic: Read an immutable reviewed-mask slice by version.
endpoints.notes: Read-only access to a committed version.

endpoints.semantic: Create a finding with enough evidence identifiers for navigation.
endpoints.notes: Evidence references are preserved for auditability. A new finding is OPEN at revision 1. prediction_variant is required when analysis_run_id is given and null otherwise.

endpoints.semantic: List findings with evidence references and status.
endpoints.notes: Filtering is additive and cannot hide evidence identifiers.

endpoints.semantic: Update only allowed mutable finding fields while preserving evidence.
endpoints.notes: Evidence identifiers and audit history are immutable.
